mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM av_asset a WHERE a.category = 'portrait_image' AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.create_time < #{cutoff} AND a.status IN ('ready', 'delete_pending', 'delete_failed') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM av_portrait p WHERE p.asset_id = a.asset_id ) ORDER BY a.create_time ASC, a.asset_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE av_asset a SET a.status = 'delete_pending', a.failure_reason = NULL, a.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId} AND a.category = 'portrait_image' AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.create_time < #{cutoff} AND a.status IN ('ready', 'delete_pending', 'delete_failed') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM av_portrait p WHERE p.asset_id = a.asset_id )

UPDATE av_asset a SET a.del_flag = '1', a.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 'delete_pending' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM av_portrait p WHERE p.asset_id = a.asset_id )

UPDATE av_asset a SET a.status = 'delete_failed', a.failure_reason = #{failureReason}, a.update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.asset_id = #{assetId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = 'delete_pending' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM av_portrait p WHERE p.asset_id = a.asset_id )
